blocks.text: In the dictionary, Iman means firmly accepting someone's word out of trust in him. In the terminology of the Deen, it is firmly accepting everything that Rasulullah ﷺ brought (including the news of the unseen) on the basis of trust in him.

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ ﷻ: (وَمٰآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لٰآ إِلهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدُونِ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet!) We did not send any messenger before you except that We revealed to him: “Indeed, there is no god (other) than Me; so (O people!) worship Me alone.”

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اللهُ ﷻ: (إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَاناً وَّعَلَي رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: The (true) believers are those who, when Allah is mentioned (before them), their hearts tremble with fear; and when His verses are recited to them, they increase them in Iman; and they place their complete trust in their Rabb.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ اللهُ ﷻ: (فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ أٰمَنُوا بِاللهِ وَاعْتَصَمُوا بِهِ فَسَيُدْخِلُهُمْ فِي رَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ وَّيَهْدِيْهِمْ إِلَيْهِ صِرَاطاً مُّسْتَقِيْماً۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: So, those who believe in Allah
